rules.title: Change to entitlement, award amount, or eligibility status
rules.rationale_template: The requested action involves directly changing entitlement or award amounts. Under Section 3.1, automated entitlement modification is prohibited without supervisor approval.
rules.human_action: Supervisor or adjudicating officer decision required to alter entitlement or award.

rules.title: Suspension, termination, or reinstatement of an award
rules.rationale_template: The requested action involves suspension/termination of an award. Under Section 3.2, the assistant must not perform or draft preparatory versions of it, and must escalate under Section 4.
rules.human_action: Supervisor decision required on suspension/termination investigation.

rules.title: Reinstatement of an award following appeal
rules.rationale_template: Appeals panel ordered award reinstatement. Under Section 3.2, award reinstatement requires supervisor approval before the system modifies the award. Triage note prepared for supervisor sign-off.
rules.human_action: Supervisor sign-off required to reinstate award on resident account.

rules.title: Initiation, alteration, or cancellation of a payment
rules.rationale_template: The requested action involves financial transaction execution. Under Section 3.3, automated initiation, alteration, or cancellation of payments is prohibited without explicit supervisor authorization.
rules.human_action: Supervisor authorization required for disbursement or cancellation of payments.

rules.title: Change to payment details (bank or card details)
rules.rationale_template: The requested action directly requests modification of payment details. Under Section 3.4, automated change is strictly prohibited without supervisor sign-off.
rules.human_action: Supervisor approval and validation of resident banking credentials required.

rules.title: Direct communication sent to a resident or third party
rules.rationale_template: The requested action involves direct external communication. Under Section 3.5, the automated assistant must not send unreviewed communications to residents or third parties.
rules.human_action: Caseworker or supervisor must author and dispatch external correspondence.

rules.title: Disclosure of resident information outside the Department
rules.rationale_template: The requested action involves external data disclosure. Under Section 3.6, disclosure of resident information requires supervisor authorization.
rules.human_action: Supervisor and data protection lead sign-off required for external disclosures.

rules.title: Creation of record asserting finding of fact on fraud/misrepresentation
rules.rationale_template: Referral involves allegations of fraud/misrepresentation. Under Section 3.7, an automated assistant must not assert findings of fact on resident conduct and must escalate.
rules.human_action: Escalate to Counter-Fraud lead and supervisor for official adjudication.

rules.title: Action that cannot be reversed by the Department acting alone
rules.rationale_template: The requested action represents an irreversible legal or administrative step. Under Section 3.8, automated execution is prohibited.
rules.human_action: Departmental legal and supervisory determination required.

rules.title: Draft a triage note for caseworker review
rules.rationale_template: Requested action is permitted under Section 2 as a routine casework proposal. It creates no binding case change until adopted by a caseworker.
rules.human_action: Caseworker review and adoption of proposed triage note.

default_rule.title: Uncertainty Fail-Safe (Treated as Requiring Approval)
default_rule.rationale_template: The requested action does not match standard Section 2 permitted categories. Under Section 6.1, where authority is unclear, it is treated as requiring supervisor approval.
